gold: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC)

selector.rationale: Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome is supported by multiple findings including the presence of basaloid cells, cystic spaces, and a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene, with no strong contradictions.

rejected.label: Gorlin syndrome
rejected.why: While some findings align with Gorlin syndrome, the presence of a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene and the specific histopathological features more strongly support Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome.
